items.title: Implement sessionId and the owner-lease.json core
items.context: Stable per-session `sessionId` — a LOCAL process-coordination id only (NOT cryptographic identity; no keys / server authority / attestation — hard boundary 1). `.koala/story/actives/<storyId>/owner-lease.json` records sessionId / hostname / pid / cwd / command / acquiredAt / heartbeatAt / optional human label. The first story-scoped mutating command for a story acquires the owner lease; owner commands refresh heartbeatAt; the lease is released when the story reaches DONE/DISCARDED and cleanup succeeds. The lease file is process metadata, not product evidence — visible in session_brief but never counted as verification evidence.
items.userSees: 用户/agent 在 story dir 看到 .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/owner-lease.json，含 sessionId/hostname/pid/cwd/command/acquiredAt/heartbeatAt；同一 session 再跑命令时 heartbeatAt 被刷新。

happy.desc: sessionId 稳定生成（同一 session 内一致）；第一条 story-scoped mutating 命令为 story 写出 owner-lease.json，含 sessionId/hostname/pid/cwd/command/acquiredAt/heartbeatAt
owner 后续 story-scoped mutating 命令刷新 owner-lease.json 的 heartbeatAt

edge.desc: story 到 DONE/DISCARDED 且 cleanup 成功后 owner lease 释放
owner-lease.json 是进程元数据——在 session_brief 可见、但不计入 verification evidence

adversarial.desc: owner-lease.json 不在 DONE 前留未提交脏写（防 F-008 同类 partial-DONE）

items.title: Non-owner story-scoped mutating command rejection gate
items.context: Build the rejection gate STRICTLY from the command-classification table that PLAN produces first (every command classified read-only / story-scoped mutating / main-shared mutating / dangerous — hard boundary 2: no missing commands, no wrongly-blocked read-only commands). Non-owner story-scoped mutating commands fail closed with owner guidance. Read-only commands (story_get / checklist_get / finding_list / session_brief / ...) never require a lease (hard boundary 3). CRITICAL reviewer-writes fork: reviewer writes (finding_add / review_pass_set) must NOT be gated by the main-agent owner lease — they take an actor/lane-scoped exception or their own current-review-run gate so three-way balance is preserved; the exact mechanism is decided in the PLAN decision. Reviewer writes still record actor/session.

items.title: Stale lease detection and takeover
items.context: A lease is stale after 30 minutes without a heartbeat. `--takeover` transfers a STALE lease to the current session and records an event. A non-stale lease requires explicit `--forceTakeover` (treated as human-approved). Takeover is dangerous-mutating-command discipline — explicit intent required, event recorded.

items.title: Ownership-aware error UX and session_brief rendering
items.context: Non-owner mutation error message per the doc's Error UX: which story is owned, owner sessionId / cwd / last-heartbeat age, whether the lease is stale, the allowed next action. session_brief ownership rendering: owner session, owner cwd, last heartbeat age, stale/active status, whether the current session is the owner, and recommended action (proceed / read-only only / takeover available / wait). For B-META, session_brief shows shared audit state separately and must not suggest story_advance.

items.title: doctor stale-lease check and multi-session regression smoke
items.context: doctor detects stale story owner leases and reports them. Multi-session regression smoke per the doc's Acceptance Criteria: two sessions mutating the same story -> second rejected with owner guidance; two sessions on different stories -> both proceed; stale-lease takeover allowed only with explicit takeover + event record; active-lease takeover rejected unless forceTakeover; session_brief tells a non-owner session to wait or stay read-only; existing read-only reviewer workflows still work; reviewer writes still succeed via the lane-scoped exception.
